independentScienceReasoning.idealGasRelation: pV=N*k_B*T=nRT. At equal p, V and absolute T, the ideal model fixes N independently of species. At common p/T, reacting stoichiometric amounts have proportional volumes.
independentScienceReasoning.realGasLimit: A real-gas relation can be expressed as pV=Z*nRT. Species- and state-dependent Z prevents unconditional equal-volume/equal-count claims; ideal-like behavior gives the stated approximation.
independentScienceReasoning.entityCounting: The amount is defined for specified entities. Molecular gases count molecules; monatomic gases count atoms. The English paragraph 3 makes this distinction explicitly.
independentScienceReasoning.molarVersusSampleVolume: V_m=V/n=RT/p for an ideal gas; total sample volume is n*V_m, not necessarily one molar volume.
